up-sqlserver.command: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile sqlserver up -d --wait sqlserver

down-sqlserver.command: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile sqlserver stop sqlserver

down-warehouse.command: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml stop warehouse warehouse-mcp

reset.command: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile sqlserver down --volumes && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait
